title: Top seed Andreeva cruises into Singapore Open quarterfinals, sets up Fernandez clash
summary: The 19-year-old top seed Mirra Andreeva dispatched Aliaksandra Sasnovich, 6-2, 6-2, to advance to the quarterfinals of the Singapore Tennis Open.
